basis: Acute leukemia of ambiguous lineage directly involves blood and bone marrow; the definition does not establish lymphoma.
Congenital pits of the posterior auricular helix; no other organ involvement established.
Phospholipid disorder with cardiomyopathy and neutropenia; skeletal myopathy occurs in 80-99%. Oral ulcers (30-79%) omitted under the four-axis cap.
Inflammation is located in the duodenum; the umbrella includes infectious and noninfectious causes without a universal immune mechanism.
Distal myopathy with hyperCKemia and episodes of rhabdomyolysis; renal injury is not established as common.
Alveolar surfactant accumulation causes respiratory failure; hypogammaglobulinemia defines immunodeficiency. Splenomegaly and leukocytosis alone do not establish blood-organ damage.
Primary melanoma arises in the central nervous system, including meninges; melanocytic differentiation does not imply skin involvement.
Skeletal defects and auricular/auditory canal malformations with hearing loss define the syndrome; both occur in 80-99%.
Syndromic antibody deficiency; associated organ abnormalities vary among subtypes and are not established across the umbrella.
Parentage identifies IgG4-related fibroinflammatory disease. Fibrotic sites vary; specific organ dysfunction is not established in at least 30% of this concept.
Spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia defines disease; blepharophimosis, microtia and nail dysplasia each occur in 30-79%. Nonspecific facial features do not add axes.
Localized intraductal papillomatosis is a breast duct lesion; breast has no axis.
Microinvasive carcinoma originates in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Umbrella of inborn organic acid metabolism disorders; neurologic injury varies substantially among subtypes and is not established above 30% across the group.
Bilateral enchondromatous lesions involve clavicles and long bones; no extraskeletal organ disease established.
Presynaptic neuromuscular junction transmission disorder; weakness, bulbar dysfunction and apnea do not establish intrinsic muscle, eye or lung damage.
Both kidneys have reduced nephron number. Secondary hypertension is separately diagnosed and does not itself demonstrate direct cardiovascular damage.
Childhood focal epilepsy; autonomic seizure manifestations do not establish damage to gastrointestinal or cardiovascular organs.
NPM1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia is a blood and bone marrow malignancy; no common additional organ damage established.
Congenital auricular sinus tract or cyst; infection is episodic, and associated renal anomalies are not established in at least 30%.
Noninfectious immune-mediated inflammation of the posterior uvea and adjacent retina; no systemic cause or other organ involvement established.
RNASEH2C interferonopathy causes encephalopathy/leukodystrophy; inflammatory chilblain lesions occur in roughly 40% of AGS. Hepatic and blood abnormalities are variable.
Intellectual disability and microcephaly define disease; atrial septal defect and nail dystrophy each occur in 30-79%. Macroglossia alone does not prove oral dysfunction.
Congenital circumferential skin creases; intellectual disability 4/4, callosal hypoplasia 2/2, microphthalmia 4/4 and cleft palate 3/4. Ureterocele 1/4 excluded.
Neoplasm originates in the gallbladder, covered by hepatic; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine organ disease.
